name: text-brush-write-on
title: Brush Calligraphy Write-On
description: Chữ thư pháp được viết ra từng nét bằng bút lông: nét vào nhỏ rồi đầy lên, cuối nét dừng hoặc vẩy mảnh đi, các nét nối nhau theo thứ tự.

moworks.author: moworks

options.strokes: [[SVG path data, 'stop' | 'sweep' | 'hook' | 'dot'], ...] in writing order ('Phúc' here, drawn by hand)

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Per stroke centre-line drawn with a variable brush (R 4.3 px on a 140 px character): 0.55 R → 1.15 R over the first 12 % (power1.out), ≈0.95 R by 42 %; sweeps taper × (1 − 0.95 power1.in) over the last 58 %, hooks over the last 16 %, stops swell +16 % at the end; dots 0.45 → 1.25 R. Each stroke max(0.18 s, length × 3.2 ms/px), 80 ms gaps, from 0.35 s (fit 3.6 s), cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1); accent ring at the tip. No data: thick sweep mask per glyph. Exit 4.5–4.85 s. Params: cỡ bút (R 4.3 px) · tốc độ (3.2 ms / px) · nghỉ giữa nét (80 ms). The brush grows from 0.55 R to 1.15 R in the first 12 % of a stroke; sweeps taper off, hooks flick, stops swell at the end, dots grow.
